capability.summary: Extract an 800-character text preview from a PDF
capability.description: Opens one PDF with pdfplumber, extracts text from every page, joins page results with newlines, and returns the document page count plus only the first 800 characters of combined text.
capability.problem_space: Short text previews and page-count inspection for text-bearing PDF files.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one PDF file path; output: JSON with total pages and at most 800 characters of newline-joined extracted text.
accepted_inputs: a readable PDF file that pdfplumber can open and parse
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.pdfplumber_extract", pages as the PDF's integer page count, and text as the first at most 800 characters of newline-joined page text. A caught file-open, PDF-parse, page-access, or text-extraction exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.pdfplumber_extract", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: extracts text only and does not extract tables despite the original broad label
returns only the first 800 characters of the combined document text and provides no per-page boundaries or coordinates
does not perform OCR, so image-only or scanned pages generally yield empty text
uses pdfplumber's default text extraction with no layout or cropping options
encrypted, missing, malformed, or unsupported PDFs use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: PDF page count and an at-most-800-character preview of newline-joined extracted text.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: count PDF pages and extract a short text sample
negative_intents: extract tables or cell structures from a PDF
